title: SCHOOLinHUB - Videos
description: SCHOOLinHUB is an innovative and holistic programme aimed at supporting the integration and language learning of migrant children aged 4–7 and their parents. Through the use of methodologies like CLIL (Content and Language Integrated Learning), Social Stories, and gamification, SCHOOLinHUB promotes inclusivity, integration, and civic engagement.
